description: Client-side review gate (CORE-2530): a Bash PreToolUse runs `xt identity merge-check` before any `gh pr merge` and blocks on a refusal, so no merge lands without a reviewer-App review at the current head; a Bash PostToolUse prints the reviewer routing reminder after `gh pr create` and never blocks it. GitHub Actions is billing-locked, so this hook plus policies/hook-dispatcher.json is the whole gate. It runs as its own process because merge-check calls the GitHub API and Substrate, which exceeds the 2 s PreToolUse budget of the shared dispatcher.
